visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dark, narrow corridor filled with swirling yellow smoke. A silhouetted figure in traditional Japanese attire stands at the end of the hall, illuminated from behind. The lighting is low and atmospheric, creating a sense of mystery. (2) A sharp cut shows the close-up reaction of a man with glasses and a woman with purple-highlighted hair, both looking startled and wide-eyed. They are standing in an indoor space with textured walls and a Japanese fan hanging in the background. (3) A young woman with long dark hair speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor seating area. She wears a beige sweater. Other group members are seated behind her at a long wooden table. (4) The scene transitions to the entrance of the 'Yumen Shrine' escape room, featuring a stone-textured wall with large red calligraphy. A character actor dressed as a traditional Japanese priest in a straw hat and green robes stands in a room with sliding paper doors (shoji). (5) Montage of gameplay: the group explores rooms with red torii gates and glowing lanterns. A miko (shrine maiden) in white and red robes walks through the set. One woman is seen wiping tears, suggesting an emotional storyline. (6) The video concludes with the group of four posing together in front of a shrine backdrop, holding props and smiling. They appear triumphant and satisfied after completing the challenge.

(3) Frequent digital UI sound effects like 'pips' and 'dings' punctuate the dialogue. The music provides a rhythmic bed under the fast-paced speech. (4) A sudden musical shift occurs mid-video to a sentimental piano ballad. The sound of soft crying and emotional sniffing is clearly audible, synchronized with the 'onion' variety text. (5) The audio resolves with an energetic Phonk-style beat featuring heavy bass and sharp transients. The group cheers together, and the narrator concludes with an enthusiastic call to action, accompanied by a final 'impact' sound effect.
